sufficiency_witness: Some individuals are represented by both valves (shared individual_id), whose measurements agree; valves of one animal are not independent observations, so each individual contributes once. Any one-valve-per-individual rule gives the same values.
analysis_specification: Join measurements to the catalogue by specimen_id. Use one value per individual (where both valves were measured their values agree; use either). RMA of log10(height) on log10(length); report slope, intercept and n.
